subject: studio/resonance
note: DOTTED LINES. Juan (2026-09-28): "for pp resonance i think the dots lines are not looking really nice, should be more continuous dots". Reading: keep the dotted leaders/arcs, but make each one read as a continuous dotted LINE — dots at a tight, constant arclength pitch along the whole path (no sparse or irregular gaps, no dots bunching at ends), the same pitch family-wide. Long plot time is acceptable for this (Juan lifted the time/pen caps); do NOT replace the dots with dashes or hairlines to save pen cycles. Applies to the whole resonance family.

subject: studio/res_backprop
note: WAVE SPACING. Juan (2026-09-29), on the res_backprop refinement ("pp_res_backprop_i…", the iterate round): "for this i think you need to have more space between the waves" and, zoomed on the K stack, "the overall spacing (not too much, just well organized and not overlapping)". Reading: no two wave packets (nor their dotted envelopes) may touch or overlap — adjacent rows keep a clear, even gap; get it mainly by giving the rows a little more pitch (and capping packet amplitude only where needed), not by spreading the layout out. Even rhythm down each stack; the whole sheet reads organized.

subject: studio/resonance
note: ORTHOGONAL BELTS. Juan (2026-09-29), looking at the continuous-dots resonance (r10): "this one looks better for example — i would do the lines more like orthogonal belts like in the airport with round corners when turning". Reading: the dotted leaders (Q/K fans into the field, V into Z/MoE, the gradient rails) stop being free curves: route them as horizontal and vertical runs joined by rounded 90° corners, bundled in parallel lanes at one constant pitch with concentric corner radii, like baggage conveyors (lineage: Harry Beck's Underground map). Keep r10's continuous dots and its spacing; keep every wave. Applies to resonance, res_backprop, res_ffn.
